verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: phone, SOLSTICE over a one-line headline and subline, two stacked badges, then a clearly separated dark CTA at the right edge. Flaws: the CTA is jammed against the right edge, there is a large dead gap between the text and the badges, the badges are close to equal in weight to the CTA, and the phone is tiny. B squeezes everything into a cramped cluster. The SOLSTICE brand label is crowded against the headline and is not aligned with it. The CTA is stacked directly under the badges with almost no gutter, so it competes with them. The headline wraps to two lines at a small size, there is a big empty gap between the phone and the text, and the phone is cropped close to the top and bottom edges.
